required_cross_operation_invariants.generation_scope: Every durable mutation has top-level generation:ResourceGeneration and request_id. Its operation authorization names the exact managed offer/model/transfer/asset/import-plan/serving-instance/owned-lease scope; nested reference generation must equal it. Catalogue/control revisions are CAS where declared.
required_cross_operation_invariants.idempotency: Persist immutable principal, installation/membership/target generations, operation kind, canonical payload digest and one outcome; conflicting request ID reuse refuses; same ID after authority change must not regain effects.
required_cross_operation_invariants.transfer_commit: Resume same pinned source/content and verified partial custody only. Cancel and publication compete atomically; a committed ready publication cannot return cancelled. Partial custody loss requires recovery; no silent fallback to changed source.
required_cross_operation_invariants.serving_custody: Release exact owned lease+generation only. Whole-server Stop requires independent controller/native approval, never port or mere lease possession. Sharing requires exact asset/backend/config/context/placement compatibility.
required_cross_operation_invariants.lease_recovery: Observer disconnect leaves durable lease unchanged. Node chooses expiries; renew reauthorizes. Orphan/restart paths reconcile exact native owner/process lifetime and lease/resource records before reuse/release, otherwise recovery-required.
required_cross_operation_invariants.fit_numeric_semantics: Per-token/per-sequence/loaded/estimated-total coefficients use exact nonnegative numerator and strictly positive denominator observations; preserve fractional source ratios. Pool margins are tagged surplus/shortfall, never clamp negative headroom to zero. Canonical ratio normalization and checked arithmetic belong to node: reduce numerator/denominator by GCD, encode zero ratio only as 0/1, encode zero margin only as surplus 0, and require strictly positive shortfall magnitude. These normalization checks grant no authority. Legacy loadlog floors division (raw_fit_coefficients); raw byte/cell/sequence operands may recover a new exact observation, but absent operands require unknown rather than relabeling a rounded legacy coefficient exact. Physical whole-byte reservation may conservatively ceil only at explicit admission boundary, never silently alter displayed evidence. Auto request settings cannot stand in for measured effective context/slots/KV/placement.
required_cross_operation_invariants.fit: Known measured facts bind exact content digests, backend build, settings/context/slots, placement and freshness/resource/policy revisions. Missing values stay unknown; estimates are marked estimates. No fit DTO grants admission.
required_cross_operation_invariants.physical_resources: Windows and WSL may alias RAM/GPU/storage. Do not sum their capacity or grant concurrent hardware leases from separate advertised IDs. Node requires proven common accounting/exclusion; until P supplies proof, affected execution stays excluded, never inferred safe.
required_cross_operation_invariants.admission: Only node computes topology/current policy, reserves resources atomically and starts private workers. Reauthorize at admission, execution, publication and every watch delivery. Client measurements, source labels, asset digests, member offers and IDs are untrusted data.
required_cross_operation_invariants.redaction: No credentials, signed URLs, private paths, executable argv/env or arbitrary URL authority in public domain values. Safe message handling must redact before publication and chunking; hashes/content verification do not establish execution approval.
required_cross_operation_invariants.subscriptions: Ordered resource streams bind cursors to current principal/scope/resource/projection generation and expiry; snapshot handoff has no event gap; stale cursor requires explicit resync. Request disconnect detaches observation only.

retained_omissions: Full CLI backend options/profile/probe/fit measurement acquisition and inference streaming operations remain unmapped; fixed cache enum is a proposal and installed backend compatibility must be checked, never silently substitute.

Startup model preparation/setup workflow, runtime installation, interpreter management, source policy changes and update policy changes require separate native/service contracts; startup choices here is read-only.
Adoption/migration detailed handlers, model filesystem export/copies and arbitrary installed extension semantics need further source mapping; there is no generic filesystem or executable escape.
No arbitrary source registration, credential acquisition or publisher trust approval API is introduced. Required approvals are governed by shared approval domain; data approval IDs are not grants.

Model/asset/resource identity issuance, content-pinning manifests, source catalogue custody, active-use removal locking, storage accounting and exact tenant mapping require reviewed node implementation.
Protocol list bounds are proposed declaration bounds, not measured physical capacities or permission to raise runtime budgets.
All ten prior jobs/agents declarations and other retained UI/CLI/API/native domains remain outside this fragment. Source inventory at whole_inventory remains incomplete discovery evidence.
validation_limits: Offline source and closed-schema checks only. No models, fake models, product imports, model servers, generated SDK changes, installed adapters or device proof performed.
